review_candidates.title: Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. THE WORK We are seeking a new Staff Software Engineer to join the Platform Engineering team of our Custody department. You'll play a key role in shaping our engineering practices, ensuring the reliability and performance of our platform across a multi-cloud environment, and empowering our engineering team to deliver innovative features with speed and efficiency. You will drive improvements in our automation, observability, and overall platform stability. WHAT YOU'LL DO Design, build, and operate scalable, resilient infrastructure across cloud providers including Azure, AWS, GCP, and IBM Cloud. Lead infrastructure architecture and reliability improvements for critical custody services. Implement and improve monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability across distributed systems. Own and evolve blockchain node infrastructure, including high availability, failover, and provider management. Build automation for infrastructure provisioning, deployments, testing, failover, incident response, and operational maintenance. Drive deployment operations and release reliability for platform and product services. Proactively identify performance bottlenecks, reliability risks, and operational gaps before they impact customers. Participate in on-call rotations, support production incidents, and help improve incident response and post-incident learning. Contribute to internal platform tools, services, and developer workflows. Create clear documentation, runbooks, and operational procedures for critical systems. Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance on infrastructure, reliability, and platform engineering decisions. WHAT YOU'LL BRING 10+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems operations for highly available production systems. Experience managing blockchain nodes, including high availability, failover, and operational resilience. Experience operating infrastructure in high-traffic, customer-critical, or security-sensitive environments. Strong production experience with PostgreSQL. Proven experience provisioning and managing infrastructure with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tools. Deep experience with containerized infrastructure and Kubernetes in highly available environments. Proficiency with programming and scripting languages such as .NET, Go, Bash, or TypeScript. Experience with messaging and queueing technologies such as RabbitMQ or AMQP. Experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, or similar platforms. Familiarity with GitOps practices using platforms like Argo CD or Flux. Experience working with confidential computing solutions like AWS Nitro Enclaves, IBM Hyper Protect Virtual Servers, or GCP Confidential Computing. Excellent ability in solving problems and the ability to diagnose complex distributed system issues. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of working effectively across teams. A focus on clear procedures, strong documentation habits, and a dedication to operational excellence. WHO WE ARE: Do Your Best Work The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support Employee giving match Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself R&R days so you can rest and recharge Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance. Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

Proactive approach to business development and client acquisition. Experience handling technical submittals and securing consultant approvals is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer
review_candidates.description: At Naphora Games Group , we’re building more than games, we’re building a global team of ambitious, driven people who are hungry to learn, experiment, and raise the bar for the next generation of games. We collaborate openly, move fast, and challenge ourselves every day to build better, smarter, and faster. Our goal is to create world-class games that players around the globe love and remember. If you thrive in a high-performance, ownership-driven environment and want to make a real impact, you’ll fit right in with us. Role Summary We’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our growing team at Naphora Games Group and help us design, build, operate, and scale robust backend systems and platforms. You’ll work hands-on with backend services, APIs, databases, integrations, and production systems, helping us build reliable and scalable solutions that can support large user bases and growing workloads. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, BI, and other teams, contributing to architecture and technical decision-making while supporting systems throughout their lifecycle, from development through production and live operations. You’ll also work with modern AI services and APIs, integrating AI models and AI-powered capabilities into our backend systems and products. Responsibilities Backend Development & Architecture Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems, services, and APIs Contribute to system architecture and long-term technical decisions Build service layers and reusable components that can support multiple products and use cases Design and optimize database schemas, queries, indexing, and data models Build asynchronous systems using queues, workers, scheduled jobs, and event-driven workflows Develop and maintain integrations with external platforms, APIs, and third-party services Scale, Reliability & Live Operations Design systems capable of supporting high traffic, large user bases, and growing workloads Support systems throughout their lifecycle, from development to production and live operations Improve backend performance, reliability, security, and maintainability Identify technical bottlenecks and implement practical, scalable solutions Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, and system health tracking Investigate and resolve production incidents, performance issues, database bottlenecks, and service degradation AI & Integrations Integrate AI models, tools, and APIs into existing products and backend workflows Build reliable interfaces between backend systems and external AI providers Design end-to-end AI-enabled workflows connecting AI services with databases, APIs, backend systems, and product logic Evaluate opportunities to use AI to improve product capabilities, workflows, and automation Collaboration & Engineering Practices Work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, and other functions to deliver new features and products Participate in technical planning, architecture reviews, and code reviews Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions clearly Contribute to improving engineering practices, system maintainability, and overall technical quality Success Looks Like Building reliable and scalable backend systems that perform effectively as our products and user base grow Designing backend services and APIs that are maintainable, reusable, and able to support multiple products Maintaining strong system reliability, performance, and uptime in live production environments Identifying and resolving production issues, bottlenecks, and scaling challenges effectively Building practical AI integrations and workflows that add value to our products and internal systems Making thoughtful technical and architectural decisions that support both immediate and long-term needs Contributing to stronger engineering practices, monitoring, reliability, and operational processes Collaborating effectively across technical and product teams Qualifications 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience, or equivalent hands-on experience building complex production systems Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining backend systems in production Proven experience working on live systems, products, or platforms serving a large number of users Experience operating or supporting production environments as part of LiveOps, platform operations, or continuous product operations Hands-on experience integrating AI tools, models, LLMs, or AI APIs into production systems and building practical solutions on top of them Ability to design and implement end-to-end AI-enabled workflows connecting AI services with backend systems, databases, APIs, and product logic Strong understanding of backend architecture, distributed systems, API design, databases, caching, concurrency, scalability, performance optimization, and system reliability Strong experience with at least one backend language or framework such as Python, Node.js/TypeScript, Go, Java, or C# Strong SQL and database design experience, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar relational databases Experience building REST APIs and service-based architectures Experience with Redis or similar caching technologies Experience with message queues, workers, or event-driven systems Experience integrating third-party APIs and external services Experience working with cloud-based production environments Hands-on experience dealing with production challenges such as traffic spikes, service degradation, incidents, database bottlenecks, scaling, and uptime Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills Able to take ownership of backend systems and technical problems from development through production Experience working with backend systems for mobile games, consumer apps, or other high-scale products is a plus If this role excites you and you’re ready to help shape the future of game development at Naphora, we encourage you to apply.
